name: progress-dialog
title: Progress dialog
description: A modal for a long task: a real progress bar read out every ten percent, the step in words, a cancel that asks once, and a done or failed end state in place.
docs: Set status to running, done, failed or cancelled and the body follows in place; focus moves to the primary button of the end state. progress runs from 0 to 1, and leaving it out gives a bar with no length. The bar is announced politely every ten percent, and a step label that is the only news at most every five seconds. onCancel runs after the person confirms the question; you set status to cancelled when it is carried out. onBackground hands the task back to the page: close the dialog and show your own banner. result is the body of the done state, with its next action; error and onRetry belong to the failed one. Escape and a click outside never close a running task.
